featured_reviews.review_text:
Review for NextGenHelpers Event:

As parents of a 2-year-old who has just started playschool a few months ago, we are delighted to share our experience with the NextGenHelpers event. Though it has only been four months since our son joined, we can already see how much he loves the school – every morning he is excited to go, and we initially enrolled him to build social skills, but he is learning much more.
The NextGenHelpers event was a wonderful initiative, thoughtfully designed to introduce children to the world of vocational education and to spark their curiosity about non-traditional professions. The way each career path was showcased was not only engaging for kids but also very insightful for parents.
Veterinary Doctor: The setup beautifully highlighted empathy and care for animals, showing children the importance of kindness towards all living beings.
Chef: With colorful displays and fun food-prep activities, kids got a glimpse of creativity and joy in cooking.
Entrepreneur: The entrepreneurial corner encouraged problem-solving and creativity, teaching kids that they can innovate and build something of their own.
Marine Biologist: Personally, this was our favorite! The ocean-themed setup with marine life models was mesmerizing. It was wonderful to see children learn about the mysteries of the sea, the importance of ocean conservation, and the fascinating role of marine biologists.
Robotics Engineer and Space Scientist: The robotics display was full of energy – simulation of playing with futuristic technology. The space theme was beautifully designed.
The event was managed seamlessly, with every detail thoughtfully planned. From the interactive setups to the smooth coordination, everything reflected the hard work and dedication of the school staff. A special mention must go to the parents who contributed their time and effort in creating projects – the results were simply outstanding and added immense value to the event.
Overall, NextGenHelpers was more than just an event; it was an experience that planted seeds of curiosity and imagination in little minds. We are truly grateful to the school for organizing something so enriching at such an early stage of education.

- Thoughts from Payal and Abhishek Merchant
